strategy: The robot will navigate toward its target location while avoiding obstacles and ensuring safe movement by prioritizing forward motion when possible, and using left or right turns as needed.
decisions: If the goal is ahead and FORWARD is clear, move FORWARD
If the goal is left and LEFT is clear, move LEFT
If the goal is right and RIGHT is clear, move RIGHT
If no clear goal direction is available, prioritize FORWARD, then LEFT, then RIGHT
If all directions are blocked, STOP
stop_condition: If all movement directions are blocked
